# Per-backedge reschedule checks run only with GOEXPERIMENT=preemptibleloops
# on amd64: the default leaf loop carries no morestack reference.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos build -o plain.exe .
go tool objdump -s 'main\.spin' plain.exe
! stdout 'morestack'
env GOEXPERIMENT=preemptibleloops
logos build -o preempt.exe .
go tool objdump -s 'main\.spin' preempt.exe
stdout 'morestack'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/preemptbackedge

go 1.27

-- m/main.go --
package main

//go:noinline
func spin(n int) int {
	s := 0
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		s += i
	}
	return s
}

func main() {
	println(spin(100))
}
